description: This Python source file provides utility functions and classes for handling user login and authentication in a proxy server environment. It includes functions for credential retrieval, user authentication, and creating token responses, as well as the LoginResult class definition. The file references external modules such as FastAPI, Prisma, and environment variables to manage user sessions and permissions.
